## Workload

Daniel Roche graded 229 sets during 165 rostered hours. This equates to 1.4 sets per hour. The workload was reviewed in the context of the current session pattern, with the grading activity and available hours considered together. No change to the current session pattern was identified as necessary.

## Quality

A sample of 13 graded sets was read again as part of the quality review. Agreement between the original grading and the subsequent review was 69.2 per cent. The result was considered alongside the workload information and the existing session arrangements. Daniel Roche and Priya Anand agreed to retain the current session pattern.

Reviewed by Priya Anand.
